policy: Allowlisted public projections omit operator topology, host/container identities, GPU UUIDs, process IDs, private paths, command arguments, and raw warning text. Numerical kernel receipts are retained verbatim after selecting only ANVIL_SAMPLING_INPUTS, ANVIL_SAMPLING_FORCED_CASE, ANVIL_SAMPLING_ORDINARY_ROW, ANVIL_SAMPLING_ORDINARY_CASE, and ANVIL_SAMPLING_REGRESSION stdout lines.

sources.projection: Selected numerical stdout receipts; omitted managed command/context, PID-bearing trace warnings, private paths, and traceback paths. Kernel summary is a bounded derivative and retains the private raw hash.
Retained source revision, file hashes, candidate image, and test count; normalized the independent-review description.
Retained predeclared cases, oracle, criteria, bounds, stop policy, and zero-inference outcome; omitted private paths, endpoint, command, and operator-only lifecycle detail.
Public-safe source note retained with one temporal clarification distinguishing the earlier diagnostic from this run.
Retained bounded build result, image identity, resource bounds, and duration; omitted command, private paths, and log location.
Retained state, exit, OOM flag, immutable image/model identity, and unavailable post-exit fields; omitted managed context and container identity.
Retained measurements and decision; clarified that the local count envelope was derived from upstream tests and is not an upstream-suite pass.
Retained independent decision and limitations; expanded compressed prose and clarified the upstream-derived envelope boundary.
Retained operational and functional restoration statuses, bounded resource deltas, phase gaps, elapsed time, and decision boundaries; omitted private container identities.

Retained immutable model/image/source/template/tokenizer/launch identities, containment, memory events, and idle engine counts; represented tokenizer file digests as file/sha256 records to distinguish artifact hashes from credential signatures; omitted process inventory, PIDs, private paths, and host identity.
Retained configured/observed identity equality, readiness, admission, drain state, and active-request count; omitted private endpoint and model-route identity.
Retained exclusive TP2 mode, restored incumbent ownership, blocked candidate, and empty unresolved set; omitted private role and workload names.
Retained availability, empty active set and blockers, and zero reclaimable bytes; omitted managed command context.
Retained count and product; omitted GPU UUIDs and host context.
Retained the complete synthetic response, usage, timing, finish reason, requested settings, and parser failure; redacted the loopback endpoint.
